name: com.xlx.speech.voicereadsdk.ui.activity.landing.multiple.SpeechVoiceMultipleExternalActivity
description: The Xinliangxiang Voice Read SDK shows an advertiser’s multi-step external-app offer here, including task instructions, progress, and the reward amount. The user follows the steps in another app and returns to continue the offer.
disableEffect: Blocking it prevents the SDK's external-app ad task from opening or completing, so rewards for that task will no longer be granted.
